core_obligations: Mirror the resolution sequence (proof lines 4310-4320): take the sequence of blowups of the curve provided by the resolution statement for the curve and perform the corresponding sequence of blowups of the surface in the corresponding closed points.

Identify the strict transform (proof lines 4320-4324): the strict transform of the curve under a blowing up of the surface is the blowing up of the curve, so the iterated strict transform is the iterated blowup of the curve, which is regular by construction.
proof_roadmap: Take the resolution sequence of the curve itself.
Perform the mirrored sequence of blowups of the surface in the corresponding points.
Identify the iterated strict transform with the resolved curve.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an integral curve on a Noetherian surface satisfying the resolution conditions becomes regular after a finite sequence of blowups of the surface in closed points (statement lines 4306-4315). The proof (proof lines 4316-4324) mirrors the resolution sequence of the curve on the surface and identifies the strict transform with the blowing up of the curve. H2: a complete constructive argument using the identification of strict transforms.
